meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤分析代码、生成计划、执行重构，并在每一步后自动运行测试，确保不引入错误。
howto.when: 当你提到“重构”、“清理”、“提取”等关键词，或要求改进代码结构时触发。

say.text: 重构 src/auth/handler.ts 中的 AuthService 类
say.note: Claude 会分析该类并执行安全重构。

say.text: 把验证逻辑提取到单独模块
say.note: Claude 会先确认目标，然后逐步提取。

say.text: 清理项目中所有过时的 API 调用
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并替换为推荐写法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze code, generate a plan, execute refactoring step by step, and run tests after each change to ensure no regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'refactor', 'cleanup', 'extract', or ask to improve code structure.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class in src/auth/handler.ts
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and refactor safely.

say_en.text: Extract validation logic into a separate module
say_en.note: Claude will confirm target and extract step by step.

say_en.text: Clean up all deprecated API calls in the project
say_en.note: Claude will scan and replace with recommended patterns.
